'''Kelin Dass''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who at one point in history served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. An obscure philosopher within the Order's long history, he authored a series of untitled musings and poetry. At least one copy was stored within the archives of the [[Jedi Sanctuary (Delriss)|Jedi Sanctuary]] on [[Delriss]], where it survived the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the abandon facility.
